relations.statement: If Rep c w and Rep c' w then c = c' (a word represents at most one configuration)
relations.hypotheses: TM0 configurations c, c' and word w

relations.statement: Every TM0 configuration has some word representing it
If A ++ st q0 :: B = P ++ st q :: S with P and S free of state symbols, then A = P, q0 = q and B = S
A machine step from a represented configuration is matched by a Rules rewrite to a word representing the next configuration
relations.hypotheses: Rep c w, TM0.step M c = some c'

relations.statement: Every Rules rewrite step of a represented word corresponds to the machine step
relations.hypotheses: Rep c w, Rules M w w'

lemmas.statement: A word represents at most one configuration
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem l_rep_unique {c c' : TM0.Cfg Γ Λ} {w : List (Sym Γ Λ)} (h : Rep c w) (h' : Rep c' w) : c = c' := rep_unique h h'

near_misses.claim: Each configuration has a unique representing word
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Representations allow blank padding at the far ends, so a configuration has many words; only the converse (word determines config) holds
